newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso untraded due to heavy rains.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso untraded due to heavy rains.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines said on Tuesday it had declared a bank holiday due to the heavy rains.
There will be no trading in peso/U.S. dollar on the Philippine dealing system.
Monsoon rains forced businesses, schools and government offices to be closed for the day.
The peso closed at a new low of 30.14 to the dollar on Monday from 29.80 as the prolonged currency turmoil in the region triggered more buying of dollars by importers.
